market_analysis.market_type_reason: The drone robotics industry is hybrid because it sells directly to commercial enterprises, governments, and defense sectors for industrial mapping and security, while maintaining a prominent consumer-facing side for hobbyists and aerial photography.
market_analysis.market_definition: The industry encompassing the design, development, and production of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) embedded with robotic software, sensors, and autonomous navigation capabilities.
market_analysis.primary_reason: Brand / Marketer is chosen because drone companies primarily compete on proprietary product ecosystems, branding, and marketing software-hardware integration directly to their respective consumer and enterprise end-users rather than operating as white-label entities.
